title: The Connected Case
question: Do hotter years bring more dust?
question_ar: هل تجلب السنوات الأكثر حرارة غباراً أكثر؟

source.fallback_note: NASA POWER T2M (MERRA-2 values served by POWER)
NASA POWER AOD_55: TOTAL aerosol optical depth from CERES SYN1deg, not dust-only

verdict.headline: No significant correlation
verdict.what: Link between Air temperature (2 m, monthly mean) and Dust optical depth (550 nm) (annual anomalies)
verdict.text: Across 25 years in All Kuwait, annual air-temperature anomalies and dust optical depth (550 nm) anomalies show a weak positive correlation: Pearson r = +0.07 (95% CI -0.33 to +0.45, p = 0.737); Spearman rho = +0.07. After removing both long-term trends, the year-to-year correlation is r = -0.09 (p = 0.653), so the link is mostly the shared long-term trends, not the individual years. Correlation is not causation.
verdict.text_ar: خلال 25 سنة في كل الكويت، يُظهر انحراف حرارة الهواء السنوي وانحراف الغبار ارتباطاً موجباً: معامل بيرسون r = +0.07 (p = 0.737). الارتباط لا يعني السببية.

evidence: X: Air temperature (2 m, monthly mean) annual anomaly from the Heat case (M2TMNXSLV T2M, access: power_fallback).
Y: Dust optical depth (550 nm) annual anomaly from the Dust case (M2TMNXAER DUEXTTAU, access: power_fallback).
Pearson correlation with Fisher-z 95% CI, Spearman rank correlation, and the same after removing each series' linear trend.
limitations: Correlation is not causation. Hot years and dusty years can share a cause (for example drought, low soil moisture or a persistent wind pattern) without one causing the other.
Both series are annual means over the same region, so they are not independent samples of weather.
With about 25 pairs of years, only fairly strong correlations can be detected.
If either input is a fallback source (NASA POWER), the same caveats as in that case apply.
limitations_ar: الارتباط لا يعني السببية؛ قد تشترك السنوات الحارة والمغبرة في سبب واحد (كالجفاف أو نمط رياح مستمر).
السلسلتان متوسطان سنويان للمنطقة نفسها، فليستا عينتين مستقلتين.
مع نحو 25 زوجاً من السنوات لا يمكن رصد إلا الارتباطات القوية نسبياً.
إذا كان أي مُدخل مصدراً بديلاً (NASA POWER) فتنطبق تحفظات تلك القضية.
